description:
Red Hot & Ra : SOLAR - Sun Ra In Brasil

1	Astroblack Orunmilá (Feat. Orquestra Afrosinfônica & Jazzmeia Horn)
2	Nature’s God (Sun Ra Sam Ba)(Feat. Munir Hossn, Drummers from Aguidavi do Jêje & Meshell Ndegeocello)
3	Nine Rocket For The Planet (Feat. Metá Metá & Edgar)
4	O Código (Black Prince Charming)(Feat. Fabrício Boliveira & Edbrass Brasil)
5	When There Is No Sun (Intergalactic Version)(Feat. Xênia França + Tiganá Santana)
6	Eu Sou Um Instrumento (Feat. Fabrício Boliveira & Jazzmeia Horn)
7	Interstellar Low Ways (Feat. Hamilton de Holanda Trio)
8	Brainville Dazidéia (Feat. Max de Castro & BNegão & Orchestra Klaxon)

Created and Produced by Xuxa Levy

* Track A1 Produced by Xuxa Levy and Ubiratan Marques
* Tracks B3 Produced by Xuxa Levy & Thiago “Big” Rabello

Produced for The Red Hot Organization by Béco Dranoff, John Carlin and Jonathan Galkin

A&R: Béco Dranoff

Brazil Executive Producer: Beth Moura
Brazil Production Assistant: Luana Moura

Design & Layout: Chris Capuozzo
Paintings, illustrations and lettering: Rimon Guimarães
Red Hot + RA Logo: Rohan Rege

Mastered by Joe Lambert at JLM Mastering, Cortland, NY

All Songs Mixed by João Milliet, assisted by Dani Mariano, except Nine Rocket For The Planet mixed by Mark Yoshizumi, O Código and Eu Sou um Instrumento mixed by Xuxa Levy

Very special thanks to Carlinhos Brown, Cleise Almeida,
Nena Oliveira, Luana Moura, Bruno Marques, Nancy Viegas, Andrea Francês Monica Cosas, Donna Matthew, Marcos Portinari, Diana Zinni and to all artists who have contributed to this project.

Red Hot Team:
Dustin Reid, Upendo Kissai, Elia Einhorn, Earle Sebastian, Kendall Thomas, Adrian Shankar

The Red Hot + Ra series is dedicated to climate justice.

Protect the environment. Promote climate equality.

Proteja o meio ambiente. Promova a justiça climática.
credits:
01. Astroblack Orunmilá (Feat. Orquestra Afrosinfônica & Jazzmeia Horn)
(Sun Ra/ Ubiratan Marques upon Ketu Nation Folk Song)

Lead Vocals: Jazzmeia Horn

Flutes: Nilton Azevedo, Julio Sant’Anna
Clarinets: Indira Dourado, Alessandra Leão
Saxophones: Gleison Coelho (Baritone), Léo Couto
(Alto Sax), Nerisvaldo Tukano (Tenor Sax)
Trumpets: Everaldo Pequeno, Karen Fernanda
Trombones: Gilmar Chaves, Toni Jaonitã
Tuba: Carlos Eduardo Alves
Vibes: Érica Sá
Percussion: Lucas de Gal, Nem Cardoso, Jeison Wilde
Electric Bass: Marcus Sampaio
Double Bass: Angelo Santiago, Marcos Sampaio
Rhodes Piano: Ubiratan Marques
Recorded by Paulo Cesar(PC) at Ilha dos Sapos
Studios (Salvador,Bahia), Assisted by Uelinton Cerqueira
